Attached: 1 image

How the "now playing" banner on my website works 🎧
▶ Apple Music, played through Longplay on Mac, iPad & iPhone
↳ scrobbled to Last.fm by Longplay itself; NepTunes (Mac menu bar) and QuietScrob (iPhone, in the background) catch everything else
↳ a Python collector in Docker on a Mac mini polls user.getRecentTracks every 30 s and writes a static JSON
↳ cover art is copied locally; artist origin, genres and a Wikipedia link come from Wikidata via SPARQL (MusicBrainz ID), iTunes Search as a cover fallback, all cached 30 days
↳ nginx serves it behind a Cloudflare Tunnel: no open port at home
↳ vanilla JS fetches the JSON every 30 s and pauses when the tab is hidden
Zero third-party requests from visitors (strict CSP), zero framework, zero build step. Bonus: the same Last.fm history gives my photos a soundtrack.
Live: https://patrickostertag.ch
Behind the scenes (in French): https://patrickostertag.ch/coulisses.html
